_doc: [camp] The trash bin at each base (automation/trash_bin.gd, drawn by automation/depot.gd). Level 1 is free; each later level costs `cost` (cubes / parts / seeds, folded by Currencies) and needs hub level `requires_level`. value_mult multiplies what a bale sells for here (on top of the hub bonus); feed_interval is the seconds between bales hopping off Lumi's back into the bin. Tuned by pace.

levels.name: Dented Bin
levels.desc: A dented wheelie bin on a rusty weigh plate. It swallows one bale at a time.

levels.name: Scrap Skip
levels.desc: A proper steel skip. Bales go in faster and weigh in a little heavier.

levels.name: Weigh Skip
levels.desc: A ribbed skip on a calibrated scale with a warning beacon. Honest weights, better pay.

levels.name: Compactor
levels.desc: A hydraulic ram presses every bale flat before it is weighed.

levels.name: Smart Intake
levels.desc: A clean white intake with a scanner seam. It sorts what it eats and pays the best rate.
